pictures.author: Andrew Shiva / Wikipedia (Godot13)
pictures.observed: Aerial campus image: partly buried straight triangular museum, narrow glazed ridge, wide splayed west wings and balcony; round Hall of Names roof light north of the axis. Independent square Hall of Remembrance and pale visitor centre remain separate.

pictures.author: Hagai Agmon-Snir
pictures.observed: West drone view: concave open concrete wings, recessed rectangular exit glazing, open projecting balcony, narrow ridge disappearing into hillside and nearby low polygonal Hall of Names roof.

pictures.author: deror avi
pictures.observed: Southeast approach: massive sloping concrete side with a rectangular recessed side entrance, triangular framed ridge glazing and thin metal approach rails. Side face reaches below the approach level.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Holocaust History Museum, Yad Vashem: mapped long triangular concrete prism, narrow glazed ridge, recessed southeast side entrance and glazed end, western concave flared concrete wings, inset exit doors and open balcony, and the low circular Hall of Names roof light belonging to the same underground museum. The independent memorial hall, visitor centre, art/exhibition buildings, northern ranges, Children's Memorial, Pillar of Heroism and Cattle Car remain separate required collection members. Underground galleries/rooms and exhibition artwork are not reconstructed.
